title: Import screen doesn't warn that the PIN won't come back after a restore
description:
Surfaced during UAT of LODGY-103. That ticket fixed the actual data gap (hostel/notification/theme prefs now travel with a backup) and made a deliberate, documented decision that the PIN (auth_prefs) does NOT travel - a new phone gets a fresh PIN setup, which is the safer default. That's the right call, but nothing on the Backup & Restore screen tells the warden this before they hit it.

Today's copy (`backup_import_description`): "Pick a previously exported backup file to restore your data - from Google Drive, Downloads, or wherever you saved it. Useful when moving to a new phone." A warden who restores everything and then lands on 'Set up your PIN' with no warning may reasonably wonder if the restore actually worked, right after LODGY-103 specifically improved how complete a restore feels. A one-line note fixes this cheaply.
acceptanceCriteria: Import screen's description (or a note shown right after a successful restore) tells the warden they'll set up a new PIN, before or immediately after they hit that screen - not left to discover it silently
Copy makes clear this is expected/normal, not a sign the restore partially failed

history.note: Found while accepting LODGY-103 - checked backup_import_description in strings.xml and confirmed it says nothing about the PIN reset, even though that's now a documented, deliberate behavior. Low priority - a copy-only fix, not a data or logic gap.
